description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” on the x-axis and two performance metrics on the dual y-axes: “Perplexity” on the left (linear scale, range 4.2 to 4.7) and “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” on the right (linear scale, range 40 to 100). The orange solid line with circular markers represents Perplexity, which starts at approximately 4.6 at 10% recent sequence ratio, drops sharply to around 4.3 at 40%, then fluctuates slightly between 4.3 and 4.4 up to 80%, before rising to about 4.4 at 100%. The blue solid line with circular markers indicates GPU Memory Ratio, which begins near 40% at 10%, rises gradually to about 55% at 80%, then jumps steeply to nearly 100% at 100%. A red dashed horizontal line at Perplexity = 4.38 and a blue dashed horizontal line at GPU Mem. Ratio = 100% serve as reference thresholds. The legend also includes “Full Cache GPU Mem.” (blue dashed line), though no corresponding data line is plotted in the graph. The gridlines aid in reading values across the range of recent sequence ratios from 10% to 100%.
